title.rendered: Jack & Jones  Viggo File Case bag

content.rendered:
The Jack & Jones Viggo File Case Bag is designed for working professionals who want a durable, stylish and functional office bag that delivers maximum convenience. Made with 100% premium PU leather, this file case bag blends elegance with long-lasting performance. Its ergonomic Twin Grip Handle, spacious structure and secure compartments make it an ideal choice for business meetings, office commutes and corporate travel. With a smart capacity of 10 liters and 15-inch laptop compatibility, this professional work bag offers the perfect balance of style and utility.The is designed for everyday use, offering excellent organization for laptops, documents, chargers, work files and travel essentials. The inclusion of a premium YKK zipper ensures smooth access while maintaining long-term durability. The adjustable and detachable shoulder straps provide versatility, allowing you to switch comfortably between a hand-carry and crossbody style. With its well-structured interior, this PU leather laptop is perfect for professionals, entrepreneurs, executives and students.

Key Features

  • Material: 100% PU Leather for premium finish and durability
  • Handle Type: Twin Grip Handle for comfortable and strong grip
  • Capacity: Spacious 10 Ltrs for laptop, files and essentials
  • Zipper: Heavy-duty YKK Zipper for long-lasting performance
  • Straps: Adjustable & Detachable Shoulder Straps for flexible carry options
  • Laptop Compatibility: Suitable for 15 Inch Laptops
  • Luggage Sleeve: Convenient back sleeve for trolley bag mounting during travel

Whether you’re heading for a meeting, office commute or a weekend business trip, the is designed to elevate your daily workflow. Its lightweight structure, superior craftsmanship and refined appearance make it a preferred choice among professionals searching for a premium laptop or PU leather file case for office use.

This PU leather laptop bag ensures that your 15-inch device is well-protected with padded compartments that minimize shock impact. The luggage sleeve adds convenience, especially for frequent travelers who want a seamless hands-free airport or railway station experience. The detachable strap design makes it versatile for those who prefer comfort and minimalism while carrying their everyday work essentials.

The is crafted keeping modern professionals in mind. Its premium look, smart storage layout, reliable YKK zipper and durable PU leather construction make it a top choice for users who want a stylish yet functional laptop. Whether you need a work, a corporate office  or a travel-friendly laptop this file case is designed to deliver excellence.

If you’re searching for a premium quality laptop for 15-inch laptops, an office file case, or a durable PU leather bag with a luggage sleeve, the stands as one of the finest options available. Its modern design, ample 10L capacity and multi-functional features make it perfect for everyday professional use.
